decision: Whether the six-gate route yields stable incremental detection beyond the strongest structural comparator, sufficient to reconsider a qualifying N2 claim.

arms.name: value-only agreement
arms.description: numeric/category agreement without structural or source-evidence gates

arms.name: structural comparator
arms.description: schema, digest and result-format validation without the complete six-gate route

arms.name: six-gate route
arms.description: G1–G6 with typed refusals, coordinate cover, policy and source replay

population: externally developed Python projects within declared parser/language scope

pilot_sample.composition: balanced natural records and prospectively perturbed records
pilot_sample.project_cap: no project may supply more than half of incremental detections

primary_estimand: paired proportion of adjudicated boundary defects detected by B2 and missed by B1

ground_truth.independence: independent of the CodeProbe implementation team where feasible
ground_truth.blinding: method labels and source of each alert concealed during initial adjudication
ground_truth.disagreement: resolved by a pre-named third adjudicator or recorded consensus conference before analysis

allocation_and_order.scenario_order: computer-generated random permutation with retained seed fixed before review
allocation_and_order.arm_presentation: de-identified labels; records presented in random order
allocation_and_order.contamination_control: adjudicators do not see the other arm outputs before their own classification

analysis.primary: paired project-clustered incremental detection estimate; all scenarios retained
analysis.uncertainty: project-level nonparametric bootstrap with 10,000 resamples plus exact counts
analysis.review_time: median and full distribution; no normality assumption
analysis.multiplicity: one primary estimand; secondary estimands interpreted descriptively under predeclared thresholds
analysis.missingness: every missing or failed run is a typed unresolved outcome, not silently excluded

pilot_continuation_rules: at least four adjudicated defects detected by B2 and missed by B1
upper 95% Wilson bound for false-alert rate <0.20
no project supplies more than half of incremental detections
median additional review time <=10 minutes per scenario
full_stage_precision: choose size after pilot to target <=0.10 half-width for the 95% interval of incremental detection, capped at 80 scenarios with cluster correction documented
abandonment_rules: stop strong N2 claim if any continuation rule fails
retain bounded-engineering framing after a null result
redesign before any efficacy claim after an adverse false-alert or timing result
falsification: The strong N2 claim fails if B2 lacks stable incremental detections, exceeds the false-alert threshold or loses its advantage under leave-one-project-out analysis.
ethics: Obtain an institutional ethics determination before recruiting adjudicators as participants; collect no unnecessary personal data.
data_management: pre-freeze project/scenario manifest, code and seeds; retain all outputs and typed failures; anonymise reviewer identifiers; publish only legally distributable material
cost: 28–45 author hours plus adjudicator time; outside B40
registration_trigger: author approval, legal access to project materials, ethics determination and frozen pilot manifest
